items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Garnier was carrying the brass band, Camellia Band... We made it go to Camellia.

ctx.x: Saxophone. Saxophone. No. Who's playing trombone, you remember? Archie Robinson and Joe Petit. Yeah, Joe Petit played with us. You must have had some trumpet players.
Oh yeah, we had good trombone. You had Dejama Garnier. Yeah, you were good. Who else? Garnier and who else? Garnier, Wooden Joe, and Bob Anthony.
Bob Anthony. And Bob Anthony. Mm-hmm. And Bob Anthony. And Bob Anthony. And Bob Anthony. And Bob Anthony. And Bob Anthony.
